topic: The history of Hasidic Judaism from its 18th-century origins to today — its founding by the Baal Shem Tov as a reaction to religious rigidity and persecution in Eastern Europe, the near-total destruction of its communities in the Holocaust, and its improbable rebuilding into large, fast-growing communities in the United States and Israel. Tell it factually and neutrally — neither idealized nor negatively spun, just what actually happened, including the genuinely difficult and painful parts of this history.
